name: house-financial-disclosures
note: This page has no choreography loop. Its behaviour is the drill paths, the member panel,
and the honest states. Everything a click can do is listed here so nothing is improvised.

drillPaths.to: trade row highlighted in the trades view, filter set to that member
filing row in the filings view, expanded
ticker view scoped to that symbol
the original PDF at the Clerk, new tab
expands in place to its extracted trades, or a pending-extraction line
the original PDF at the Clerk, new tab
ticker view scoped to that symbol, panel closes
ticker view scoped to that symbol

memberPanel.routeBehaviour: pushState on open; popstate closes; the same route loaded directly renders the full-page profile
memberPanel.swap: clicking another member while open replaces the content in place; there is never a second panel
memberPanel.focus: focus moves to the panel heading on open and returns to the triggering link on close
memberPanel.bodyScroll: locked while open on desktop; panel body scrolls
memberPanel.reducedMotion: no slide; panel and scrim appear

builder.restingState: one 44px light pill plus one mono query line with Edit, Run, CSV, JSON links
builder.expand: Edit or Generate opens an editor under the query line, same white ground, 720 max width, never dark
builder.seed: query is derived from the rail filters and re-derives on every filter change until the user edits it
builder.run: results render as a table under the editor; cmd+enter runs
builder.guests: may run against public datasets; only saving needs sign-in

filters.clear: one control in the rail head resets everything to defaults
filters.scope: every filter scopes the metric row, the chart, the leaderboard, the active view, and the builder seed

sorting.byAmount: sorts on the bracket midpoint internally; the UI shows the bracket only and marks the sort with ~est. beside the column head

states.loading: per filing row, a spinner in the trades count cell while extraction is fetched; never a whole-page spinner for one row
states.pendingExtraction: row text 'Scanned filing, trades pending extraction' in #b45309, with the PDF link still present
states.noTrades: row text 'none' in muted; the filing still opens its PDF
states.sample: SAMPLE DATA chip in the eyebrow row, always visible while the ingest has not run
states.emptyFilter: 'No trades match. Try clearing <filter name>.' with the offending filter named and a one-click clear
states.noDate: a filing with no usable date shows 'no date' in muted mono; typo dates from the source are stored without a date, never corrected
states.unknownFilingType: an undocumented legacy code shows its raw letter in the type chip

keyboard.Escape: closes the panel, then any open sheet
keyboard.cmd+enter: runs the query when the editor is open
keyboard.tab: rail, tabs, table rows, panel; nothing decorative is focusable
